cases.refreshed: Teens Reach is the youth council for the San José Public Library for ages 13-18, providing a key way for young adults to build their leadership skills by developing and participating in library activities, as well as becoming library advisors and advocates. Rose Garden's Teens Reach group meets monthly on the second Tuesday with socializing and fun at 4:00 pm. Our in-person meet up plans for this school year include: Teen Volunteer Opportunities; Election for Advisory Board; Community Youth Engagement; Games & Activities; Snacks; Guest Speakers. Bring a friend, and learn more about what to expect with volunteering this year. If you are new to volunteering with the San Jose Public Library, please visit the Teens Reach: Community Service webpage for more information and be sure to create your online volunteer account (click "Sign Me Up" under Rose Garden Branch).

cases.refreshed: Join Mayor Kitty Moore for Taiso, a simple and energizing Japanese exercise routine that promotes flexibility, circulation, and overall wellness. Hosted by the City of Cupertino and the Cupertino-Toyokawa Sister Cities Committee (CTSC), this free event introduces participants to Radio Taiso, a nearly 100-year-old Japanese exercise routine designed for people of all ages and fitness levels. As part of Mayor Moore's Initiative, the event encourages residents to stay active, connect with others, and explore a fun and accessible wellness tradition practiced in Japan for generations. Event Details Date: Saturday, November 14 Time: 10 to 11 a.m. Location: Cupertino Community Hall Address: 10350 Torre Ave, Cupertino, CA 95014 Event Registration Visit cupertino.gov/taiso to reserve your spot. Special Guests & Raffle Prizes The event will feature a special appearance by the Ctsc-sponsored 2026 San Francisco Cherry Blossom Festival Queen. Attendees will also have a chance to win raffle prizes, including tickets to Hakone Estate and Gardens. Raffle winner must be present to win.

cases.refreshed: Children in Grades K to 5 are invited to celebrate Fall with us by making fall inspired crafts at the Milpitas Library. All materials will be provided. Registration opens November 13 at 3:30 PM. Thank you to the Friends of the Milpitas Library for making this program possible. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Please join us for a lively kids' Zumba-style inspired class featuring multicultural music, joyful movement, and a special Dance Circle to celebrate connection and fun! Participants will start with warm-up songs then transition into interactive movement-based activities like balancing, jumping, freestyle and more. Recommended for children ages 5-13, but all kids are welcome! Free. No registration required. This program has been generously sponsored by the Friends of the Vineland Library.

cases.refreshed: Celebrate the spirit of Diwali with our Wee Love ART program, featuring vibrant Diwali-inspired art activities. Delve into the rich cultural heritage of Diwali as we explore traditional symbols, colors, and motifs through hands-on art projects. Join us for a creative journey that honors the beauty and significance of this festive occasion. Note: This program will take place during the library's weekly Art Club.
